messages:
sylvie: Opened a small PR to update the model catalog entry for orion-xl: clarify supported quant variants, add tiny SDK snippet for detecting runtime, and fix a broken cross-link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534

omar: Thanks. Can we be explicit which quant variants are experimental vs recommended?

sylvie: Added a short table: recommended: float16, quant-int8; experimental: quant-int4 (may fallback on older kernels).

kevin: Please include one-line med/p95 numbers for a 256-token gen for both GPU and CPU fallbacks so customers know the perf delta.

sylvie: Done: GPU med 62ms p95 120ms; CPU fallback med 380ms p95 810ms. Also added sequence_limit: 6144 and a note that long contexts increase the CPU penalty.

tara: Can you add a minimal Python snippet that shows how a client can detect fallback and optionally retry a supported variant? Keep it very small.

sylvie: Snippet added in PR:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
r = c.generate("Summarize the changes", model="orion-xl:quant-int4")
print(r.text)
if getattr(r, "runtime", "unknown") != "gpu":
    # fallback detected
    r2 = c.generate("Summarize the changes", model="orion-xl:quant-int8")
    print("Retried with int8, result:", r2.text)
```
docs-bot: PR opened by sylvie: #534 reviewers requested: @omar @kevin @tara

omar: Small ask: link to the runtime compatibility guide and add a one-line migration checklist for Dedicated (verify pinned pools have updated kernels).

sylvie: Added links and migration checklist. Fixed the cross-link from /models/orion -> /catalog/orion-xl. Will squash bench commit after reviews.

kevin: I will sanity-check the bench methodology tomorrow.

tara: Quick pass after kevin.

sylvie: Thanks — will ping support and the Dedicated runbook owners once merged.

(END)
